a8877de42511.why: House night in a church hall with Big Cee, the longtime DEEP resident and a foundational LA house figure. It's a quirky setting, $10 donation.

c044f992b646.why: The Hustle is a reliable first-and-third-Saturday disco and groove residency, close to home and easy to say yes to.

9cf02a447dd3.why: Free early rooftop deep-house with Made to Move-orbit DJs. It's an easy start to the night rather than a destination.

4377c346f2e8.why: RA pick with an LA producer on the bill (Ava Blank, who works across house, IDM and UK garage). At $33 it's a bit steep for the draw.
